name: RubyOS 4.9.1
changelog: Setup Wizard (Welcome, Language, Keyboard, Username, Password optional, then Lock screen). Developer RubyOS: tapping build 7 times now restarts into Developer mode with Welcome Developer boot + desktop watermark, Terminal auto-rooted, sudo disable/enable apps, Developer Settings disable toggles, Custom App File into the Ruby Store + .rubyapp export/import. Permissions: Location now has Ask to grant + explains Earth IP fallback, Motion sensors shows No hardware on Chromebooks, USB notes the built-in webcam is normal.
